name: restate-oci
description: Restate 1.7.13 from the official Docker image (AVX2 build); the server must come up and answer.

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  if wget -q -T 5 -O /tmp/h$i http://127.0.0.1:9070/health && wget -q -T 5 -O /tmp/d$i http://127.0.0.1:9070/deployments; then
    echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED
    echo "hydo-restate: step $i deployments=$(cat /tmp/d$i)" > /dev/ttyS0
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

invariants.msg: after the run (and any restart) the Restate server answers its health and admin endpoints
invariants.cmd:
n=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED)
if wget -q -T 5 -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:9070/health && wget -q -T 5 -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/restate/health; then
  echo "answers; steps answered=$n of 6"; exit 0
fi
echo "no answer at the end; steps answered=$n of 6"; exit 1
